summary: First test iteration for Dash Cam MVP (Expo web + FastAPI). Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass — health, event create (impact + trip), sorted list, single delete, delete all, and register-push returns 502 (non-crash) with placeholder key as expected. Frontend web preview: Record tab loads, camera auto-permission via Playwright bypasses gate, auto-start kicks in (REC pill ticks), preview-note visible, unit toggle (kmh/mph) works and syncs with Settings, mark-event triggers impact banner, save-clip increments footer count, toggle-recording pauses→REC. History tab loads with 'Today' group, IMPACT tag and 'no video' meta present, Impacts filter shows only impact clips, tapping row opens clip-detail, delete requires two taps, clip-lock toggles. Settings tab: speed-unit sync works, clip-length updates footer text ('1 min clips'), sensitivity subtitle updates threshold ('1.5g'/'2.2g'), delete-all requires second tap and clears history to empty state ('No trips recorded yet'). Auto-start and Dual camera switches present. Confirmed BUG: theme-dark/theme-light does NOT change the app background on web (settings-screen bg stays rgb(255,255,255) after theme-dark). Root cause: theme.ts relies on Appearance.setColorScheme() + useColorScheme() which is a no-op on react-native-web, so setTheme('dark') updates the store but useTheme() never re-evaluates. Segmented control highlights the choice visually but no colors switch. React Native issues detected: props.pointerEvents and shadow* deprecation warnings (main agent said these are expected — not reported as bugs).

ui_bugs.issue: theme-dark and theme-light segments highlight visually but the app background/surface colors do not change on web. useTheme() is driven by useColorScheme() which never updates because Appearance.setColorScheme is a no-op on react-native-web. Settings-screen backgroundColor remained rgb(255,255,255) after selecting Dark. Must wire useTheme() to also read the persisted theme preference from useSettings (fall back to useColorScheme only when preference === 'system').

action_items: Fix theme toggle on web: in src/theme.ts useTheme(), read the persisted preference from useSettings (theme: 'light'|'dark'|'system'); only fall back to useColorScheme() when preference === 'system'. This will make makeStyles() re-run when the user changes theme regardless of platform. Verify Record screen (keep colors.feed=black) and Settings/History screens both switch surface colors.
critical_code_review_comments: theme.ts: makeStyles memoizes on `colors` from useTheme(), which is driven by useColorScheme(). setColorScheme() is documented as a no-op on RN Web — so in-app theme toggle only works on native. Consider making the settings.theme preference the source of truth for useTheme() to unify web + native behavior.

backend/server.py: OK — MongoDB _id excluded via projection, push failure non-blocking, correct status codes. Small nit: register-push endpoint currently uses status_code=201 on success but with placeholder key it will always error out; that's expected until EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY is provisioned.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (11/12 flows pass; theme toggle broken on web)

seed_data_creation: No permanent seed data. Test device IDs are prefixed TEST_ and cleaned up via DELETE /api/events during test runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://carguard-vision.preview.emergentagent.com. Frontend .env key is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) — reuse conftest.py fallback. Playwright must grant permissions=['camera','microphone'] before goto so the auto-start recording flow works; then the camera-permission gate never appears and REC pill auto-ticks. Theme fix should be verified by asserting getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('[data-testid="settings-screen"]')).backgroundColor changes between theme-light and theme-dark taps.
rca_of_issue:
BUG: Theme toggle no-op on web.
  Repro: Open Settings tab → tap testID='theme-dark'.
  Expected: App surface turns black (dark theme colors).
  Actual: Segmented control highlight moves to Dark, but every screen keeps its light colors.
  RCA: src/theme.ts:157 useTheme() = useColorScheme() → themes[scheme]. setColorScheme() (line 149) calls Appearance.setColorScheme, which react-native-web doesn't implement, so useColorScheme() never re-emits and makeStyles' memo never invalidates. app/_layout.tsx:53 ThemeSync only calls setColorScheme; it never propagates the store value to useTheme().
  Mitigation: In useTheme(), read `theme` from useSettings and choose scheme as: theme === 'system' ? (useColorScheme() ?? 'light') : theme. This makes the store the source of truth on both native and web.
